[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | render = [[File:Ribcage Trophy.jpg|110px]] }} [[Saurian Bone]]s are trophies dropped by various types of [[dinosaur]]s in Eye of the North. ==Acquisition== * [[Tarnished Coast]] **[[Angorodon]] **[[Ceratadon]] **[[Ferothrax]] **[[Raptor]] **[[Raptor Nestling]] **[[Tyrannus]] {{ongoing item research}} ===Farming=== ==== [[Riven Earth]] ==== [[File:Saurian-Bone-Farm-1.jpg|thumb|right|Farming Raptors in [[Riven Earth]].]] Leave from [[Rata Sum]], making your way towards [[Rekoff Broodmother]]'s cave to the south, where many raptor nestlings can be found. This route is commonly used by Warriors running [[Hundred Blades]] and [[Mark of Pain]] builds for fast farming (''see notes''). ==== [[Sparkfly Swamp]] ==== [[File:Saurian-Bone-Farm-2.jpg|thumb|right|Farming Raptors in [[Sparkfly Swamp]].]] Start from [[Gadd's Encampment]], picking off the patrolling groups of raptors as you head towards [[Bloodstone Caves]]. Beware of [[Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh]] as he patrols relatively close to the entrance to Bloodstone Caves. ==Collectors== {{:Aell/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|8th February 2010 and 12th November 2012|Riven Earth|5 [[Saurian Bone]]s}} ==Notes== * [[Rekoff Broodmother]]'s raptor cave in Riven Earth has long been a popular farming spot for players due to the vast amount of melee enemies in a closed area.
